name: Amara Minerals Limited
summary: Amara Minerals Limited engages in the exploration of mineral properties in Australia and Brazil. It explores for gold and lithium. Its flagship property is the Adelong Goldfield Project located in southern New South Wales. The company was formerly known as Adelong Gold Limited and changed its name to Amara Minerals Limited in May 2026. Amara Minerals Limited was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Melbourne, Australia.
